propositions: 344 closed bugs lack aggregated lens for close_class distribution, detection channel, age, caused_by fan-in, and time-to-close trends; ad-hoc scripts currently answer these questions
bug_trends lens must surface pre-convention era where close_class is absent (~214 bugs) as explicit labeled MISSING cohort alongside vocabulary classes to prevent silent data mixing

FLOW dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within ctx range; STOCK dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, caused_by fan-in) measure point-in-time over current store and deliberately ignore range
detected_by field is sparse/absent; dimension must degrade gracefully to unavailable state without affecting other dimensions
implementation requires new module registration via standard registry pattern, idempotent spec() appends, side-effect import in __init__.py, and documented range semantics in user-guide
